reviews.title: Frustrating App for Logging in
reviews.text:
Sunday I was trying to upload a recipe and was told that I could try again the next day so I came back on the next day and it showed I had been logged out and won’t allow me to log back in says “Sorry, we’re unable to log you in right now.”
Tried another email and had no problem creating an account with that email and logging in…
Decided to try again with my original email and no luck still the same error message.
I used Sign in with Apple so I Don’t understand why it’s having issues signing in. It’s not like I forgot my password or anything.
The help online says to click “forgot my password” but each time I try to log in that option is not there. Very frustrating!

reviews.title: Can’t login
reviews.text:
When I try to login with Facebook I don’t even get the login screen. I get an error screen saying we’re sorry something has gone horribly wrong. Useless error screen doesn’t tell you the actual fault so you can fix it or get help.

Was trying to read the what’s new splash screen but accidentally closed it by grazing the screen because the devs didn’t disable the close gesture or make the splash screen taller so that can’t happen. Uninstalled, reinstalled which started the login mess. Got back in and still couldn’t see the splash screen because the devs didn’t make the splash screen accessible again from settings. Bad design all round

reviews.title: Investing idea..
reviews.text:
Like other free cooking sites but they want $$ and force you to pay a monthly subscription to see their most popular recipes. 
Some good ones maybe but lot's of stuff not worth looking at. 
I was disappointed that a VERY simple recipe I posted was removed because it did not meet their formatting requirements yet allowing AI to write the recipe for you based on just a photograph is somehow alright!!
